necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk. This clinical presentation supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
